title: Pan-Seared Fish Fillet with Ukrainian-Style Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring pan-seared fish fillet paired with Ukrainian-style skewers.

ingredients.name: Nutty Skewers
ingredients.notes: made with kissed and ukrainian ingredients

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Add olive oil to the skillet and sear the fish for 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, prepare the Ukrainian-style skewers by brushing with lemon juice and seasoning with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve the pan-seared fish fillet with Ukrainian-style skewers.
Garnish with kissed bread, if desired.
